answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 30769 Country: United Kingdom Title: I did istikaraah to see if I should marry the person I wish to marry and I dreamt that a little girl gave me red roses to give to the local imam. Please note I am not yet a Muslim but am looking to convert. My friend that I wish to marry is a Muslim and he also did istikaraah and the had 3 dreams: 1. Me and him were sitting in separate rooms 2. Me and him were going through different doors and 3. He was falling and I was just watching him fall Please would you interpret them for Me and tell me what they mean. Question: I did istikaraah to see if I should marry the person I wish to marry and I dreamt that a little girl gave me red roses to give to the local imam. Please note I am not yet a Muslim but am looking to convert. My friend that I wish to marry is a Muslim and he also did istikaraah and the had 3 dreams: 1. Me and him were sitting in separate rooms 2. Me and him were going through different doors and 3. He was falling and I was just watching him fall Please would you interpret them for Me and tell me what they mean. Thank you Jazak Allah kher Answer ID: 30769 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 322/286/B=1432) The nikah of Muslim male is valid only with Muslim female. Nikah is not valid with non-Muslim. Your istikhara as well as was not valid. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
